# Why aren't my YouTube chapters showing up?

> Free YouTube chapters checker: finds why chapters do not show (no 0:00 start, fewer than three, under 10 seconds, out of order), fixes the list, and converts Premiere or Audacity markers to chapters, chapters.json, FFmetadata and WebVTT. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
